name: Amp Boxes
desc: Always-on computers you deploy the things you build with Amp onto.
desc_zh: 用来部署你用 Amp 做出来的东西的常驻计算机。
solves: An agent can build the app but nobody wants to own the machine it runs on; a box is that machine, kept running for you.
solves_zh: 智能体能做出应用，但没人想养那台运行它的机器；box 就是这台机器，由它替你保持运行。
best_for: The thing the agent built needs to stay online after the session ends.
best_for_zh: 智能体做好的东西需要在会话结束后还保持在线。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — ampcode.com/chronicle news feed）。 Amp for Windows shipped the following week, 2026-11-17. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「Boxes」，加上产品名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://ampcode.com/news/boxes
